correctness.rationale: The Fourier reduction follows directly from the differentiated nonlocal PDE. For N=2 the displayed determinant is strictly negative whenever q>0 and aggregate interaction is positive, forcing two distinct real eigenvalues; at q=0 the Laplacian eigenvalues are real. The three-phenotype parameter tuple has exact normalized positive net interaction and a strictly positive heat kernel. Exact characteristic cubic, negative discriminant, root bracket and trace make the conjugate pair dominant and growing. Exact Routh–Hurwitz inequalities for n=2,3 and a uniform high-wavenumber norm bound for all n>=4 exclude every other nonzero unstable harmonic. The checker regenerated the exact data and was executed successfully.

originality.rationale: The motivating 2026 primary article was read through its model, Fourier reduction and oscillations sections. It proves a Metzler/Perron–Frobenius obstruction for fully attractive cross-interactions and supplies a three-phenotype signed example with negative net interaction; it neither states the determinant obstruction for all two-phenotype positive-net rank-one couplings nor gives a normalized positive-net three-phenotype example. A 2025 two-species chirality article has complex modes but is outside the same rank-one switching class. A 2022 symmetric energy formulation has distinct restrictions. A 2020 nonlocal cross-diffusion full text was inaccessible and remains a documented priority risk. Searches did not show implication by these sources; absence of a match is not a priority certificate.
